description: FAKE reference vectors for mycarlos-send/1 (patient to clinic), DRAFT for review. No signature, key, cipher or randomness is used: signing inputs are bytes, and every hash below is over fixed FAKE bytes. Not a conformance claim for any real component.
canonical_json: sorted keys, no spaces, UTF-8, strings and integers only (RFC 8785 for these objects)
frame: each part preceded by its length as eight bytes, big endian

definition.message_head: sha256(frame('mycarlos-send/1 message', message_id16, sha256(sealed_envelope), head_of_attachment_0, head_of_attachment_1, ...))

queued.means: kept in the sent record; nothing has been sent yet

sending.means: parts are being uploaded; resumes where it stopped
sending.never_means: that the portal has all of it

received.set_by: portal (reply the app checks: message_id, chain_head, received_at)
received.means: the portal holds every part and the chain checked; it cannot read them

collected.set_by: clinic system, by a signed acknowledgement (state collected)
collected.means: the clinic's system fetched, opened and checked the message
collected.never_means: filed, seen or read by anyone

filed.set_by: clinic system, by a signed acknowledgement (state filed)
filed.means: stored in the clinic's pending-review queue for staff
filed.never_means: that any staff member has read, reviewed or acted on it

refused.set_by: portal (limits, device) or clinic system (signed acknowledgement with a reason)
refused.means: not accepted, with one reason from a fixed list; nothing is kept

expired.set_by: app or portal, when expires_at passes before the clinic collected it
expired.means: the portal deleted what it held; the sent record keeps that it expired

recalled.set_by: clinic system, by a signed acknowledgement after a recall request
recalled.means: removed from the pending-review queue before it was accepted into a chart
